hebrewText: וַ/יָּשִׂ֨מוּ֙ אֶת כֵּלָ֔י/ו בֵּ֖ית עַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְ/אֶת גְּוִיָּת/וֹ֙ תָּקְע֔וּ בְּ/חוֹמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית שָֽׁן

tokens.bdb: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
tokens.kjv: armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, [phrase] furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, [idiom] one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, [phrase] psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, [phrase] whatsoever.

tokens.bdb: Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan
tokens.kjv: Asharoth, Astaroth. See also H1045 (בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת), H6253 (עַשְׁתֹּרֶת), H6255 (עַשְׁתְּרֹת קַרְנַיִם).

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
a body, whether alive or dead
to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping)
tokens.kjv: blow (a trumpet), cast, clap, fasten, pitch (tent), smite, sound, strike, [idiom] suretiship, thrust.

tokens.bdb: Beth-Shean or Beth-Shan, a place in Palestine
